subject: Assamese
instruction: Explain the pedagogical scope, core concepts, and assessment objectives for Grammar in CBSE Class 12 Assamese.
expected_response: Under CBSE Class 12 Assamese (114), Unit-3: Grammar covers fundamental foundational principles aligned with NEP 2020 competency-based learning framework. Learners are evaluated on conceptual understanding, problem-solving application, and analytical rigor.
